title: Finance — portfolio review, research, screening, trade plans, paper accounts and reports
description: Use this for any request about a portfolio, a single stock, the market regime, screening for candidates, sizing or planning a trade, validating a strategy, or a portfolio report. Imports a holdings file from any brokerage into a broker-neutral portfolio record, tracks it as a paper account (many accounts supported), and routes the request through non-overlapping playbooks (P0-P12). Trade plans are shared outputs that any playbook can emit and any later playbook can reuse. Live-account effects are gated per operation and are not implemented in this version.
author: sox-ecosystem

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words.

account_id.description: Paper account id under .finance/accounts/. Optional for analysis of a single name.

as_of.description: ISO date for the analysis. Defaults to the snapshot date.

playbook.description: The playbook id that ran, e.g. P0, P5, P12.

artifacts.description: Paths of receipts, plans and reports written.

next.description: The next stage the routing table allows, or none.
